name: crosslg-cont-en-og-sm-3-benchmark-grade
description: A small English benchmark intended to measure models' ability to predict the educational grade level or readability band of short texts. It evaluates how well models capture linguistic features associated with different school grade levels and readability standards. Typically used to compare classification and readability-prediction approaches on a standardized split.
reputation: A niche, small-scale dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited community adoption outside users of the originating project.
